The Router's observation of 'fused rivets' is the critical artifact here.

Secondary artifacts include 'smudged' metallic reflections lacking crisp optical fidelity (Severity ~1.5) and slight edge haloing against the background (Severity ~1.0). These are typical diffusion model artifacts but do not destroy the overall recognizability of the object.
